title: 10 Beginner Wig Styles That Look Expensive (But Take 5 Minutes)
description: Fast, realistic wig styles for daily wear: parts, waves, half-up looks, and low-tension styles.

## Style #1: Deep side part
## Style #2: Soft waves
## Style #3: Low bun (wig-safe)

## Style #9: Face-framing layers
## Style #10: Wet look curls

## Pro tip
Choose density based on your face shape and lifestyle (daily wear = lighter density).
